senses.gloss: पवित्र- + आरोहण पवित्र- + आरोहण, n. the name of a festival, Pañc. 34, 18.
पवन- + आशिन् पवन- + आशिन्, m. a snake.
पवन- + तनय पवन- + तनय, m. Hanumant, the son of the wind.
† पव् पव्, i. 1, Ātm. To go (v. r.).
पव पव, i. e. पू + अ, n. Cowdung.

पवन पवन, i. e. पू + अन,
 I. m.
 1. Wind, air, Śāk. d. 55.
 2. A potter's kiln, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 117.
 3. A proper name.
 II. m. (or n.) The sacred fire. []
 --Comp.

पावन पावन, i. e. पू + अन,
 I. adj., f. नी.
 1. Purifying, Man. 2, 26.
 2. Pure, Rām. 1, 27, 17.
 II. m.
 1. Fire.
 2. A proper name.
 III. f. नी, The name of a river.
 IV. n.
 1. Purifying, Man. 11, 85.
 2. A means of purifying, 11, 177.
 --Comp.

पवमान पवमान (properly ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. of पू, i. 1), m.
 1. Wind, Ragh. 8, 9.
 2. Agni, the deified fire.
 3. The moon.

पवि पवि, m.
 1. The iron band of a wheel (ved.).
 2. The thunderbolt of Indra, Śatr. 14, 219. Perhaps akin to Lat. pavire, puvire; παίω, πταίω.

पवित्र पवित्र, i. e. पू + त्र,
 I. n.
 1. A means of purifying, Man. 11, 85.
 2. Sacrificial grass, Man. 2, 75.
 3. Prayer, Man. 11, 225.
 II. m. pl. The name of a class of deities.
 III. f. त्रा, The name of a river.
 IV. adj., f. त्रा.
 1. Purifying, Rām. 1, 1, 94.
 2. Pure, Man. 3, 235.
 --Comp.

पवित्रक पवित्र + क,
 I. n. The vessel in which an Argha or oblation is presented(?), Yājñ. 1, 250.
 II. As latter part of comp. adj., a substitute for पवित्र.
 --Comp.
पवित्रता पवित्र + ता, f., and पवित्रत्व पवित्र + त्व, n. Purity, Utt. Rāmac. 168, 14.
पवित्रय पवित्रय, a denomin. derived from पवित्र with अय, Par. To purify.

पवित्रिन् पवित्रिन्, i. e. पवित्र + इन्, adj.
 1. Purifying, MBh. 1, 1543.
 2. Pure.

पावक पावक, i. e. पू + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Belonging to Agni, Utt. Rāmac. 142, 12.
 2. Pure.
 II. m.
 1. Fire, or its deified personification, Man. 2, 187.
 2. A kind of Ṛṣi.
 3. Name of several plants.
पावकि पावकि, i. e. पावक + इ, patronym., m. A son of fire, i. e. Kārttikeya.
पावमानी पावमानी, i. e. पवमान (vb. पू), + अ + ई, f. The name of hymns referring to the preparation of the सोम, Man. 5, 86.
पावर पावर, a corrupt form of द्वापर, The die which is marked with two points, Mṛcch. 33, 9.
